test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf810a2424745d2aa966fdb7dd5f80d955fb4aa7f4050006dbc8e44daa337452.png]
solution: Here, we use the figure (2) and (3) to find opposite faces. In figures (2) and (3) faces showing 5 and 6 are common, which means the face showing 2 is opposite to the face showing 1.
